# freshdesk_ticket_field (Resource)

A field on the ticket form.

~> Deleting a custom field permanently removes the data captured in it on every existing ticket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "freshdesk_ticket_field" "issue_type" {
  label                  = "Issue Type"
  label_for_customers    = "What went wrong?"
  type                   = "custom_dropdown"
  displayed_to_customers = true
  required_for_customers = true

  choices = [
    { value = "Refund" },
    { value = "Faulty product" },
    { value = "Not delivered" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label shown to agents.
- `type` (String) Field type, for example `custom_text`, `custom_dropdown`, `custom_checkbox`, `custom_date` or `nested_field`. Changing it forces a new field.

### Optional

- `choices` (Attributes List) Options of a dropdown field, in the order they are shown. Only meaningful for the `custom_dropdown` and `nested_field` types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--choices))
- `customers_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether customers may edit the field in the portal.
- `description` (String) Help text shown beneath the field.
- `displayed_to_customers` (Boolean) Whether the field appears in the customer portal.
- `label_for_customers` (String) Label shown in the customer portal. Required when `displayed_to_customers` is `true`.
- `position` (Number) Position of the field on the form.
- `required_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether agents must fill the field in.
- `required_for_closure` (Boolean) Whether the field must be set before a ticket is closed.
- `required_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether customers must fill the field in.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the field was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in field rather than a custom one.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the field.
- `name` (String) Internal name Freshdesk generated for the field.
- `updated_at` (String) When the field was last changed (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `choices`

Required:

- `value` (String) Stored value of the choice.

Optional:

- `label` (String) Label shown for the choice. Defaults to `value`.
- `position` (Number) Position of the choice in the dropdown.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the choice.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_ticket_field.example 42
```
